messages.author: eb46cdd8722857c4
messages.subject: 2x2 ANOVA
parts:
Hi,

I'm working through the brainGraph manual, version 2.7.0.  I'm interested in running the 2x2 ANOVA model, but I'm now stuck.  I've set up everything the way I think the manual specifies (using cell.means because that's what I'm used to from FSL):

> covars[1:4,1:3]
   Study.ID COC HIV
1:    00001   1   0
2:    00002   1   0
3:    00003   1   0
4:    00004   1   0
...

> X <- brainGraph_GLM_design(covars[, c('Study.ID', 'COC', 'HIV')], coding='cell.means', int=c('COC', 'HIV'))
> X[1:4,]
     COC0:HIV0 COC0:HIV1 COC1:HIV0 COC1:HIV1
[1,]         0         0         1         0
[2,]         0         0         1         0
[3,]         0         0         1         0
[4,]         0         0         1         0
...

> con.mat <- matrix(c(1, -1, -1, 1) / 4, nrow=1, dimnames=list('COC X HIV'))
> con.mat
          [,1]  [,2]  [,3] [,4]
COC X HIV 0.25 -0.25 -0.25 0.25


But:

> brainGraph_GLM(g.glm, measure='E.nodal.wt', covars=covars[,c('Study.ID', 'COC', 'HIV')], X=X, con.mat=con.mat, alt="greater")
Error in fastLmPure(X, y, method = 2) : NROW(y) == nrow(X) is not TRUE


I get the same error when using the 'effects' method instead of 'cell.means'.

Any ideas how to get past this?

-syam

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] 2x2 ANOVA
parts:
Hi Syam, what that error means is that the number of rows in the design matrix does not equal the number of outcomes, which in this case would be the number of graphs. Could you send me 2 pieces of information:

1. "nrow(X)" and/or "dim(covars)"
2. "length(g.glm)"

Chris
